name: חֲמָתִי
summary: The Hamathites, the people of Hamath, last of the families descended from Canaan; the singular names them collectively. The gentilic is formed from the place name Hamath.

evidence.note: הַחֲמָתִי closes the list immediately before the narrator tells how the Canaanite families dispersed.

note: Moved from the former word entry `7eamaatiy` (old root key חמת).
